name: developer-sandbox
description: A Linux developer machine with a shell and the public internet, but no accounts or credentials for any external service.

tools.bash: run shell commands on Linux: install packages from public registries (pip, npm, apt, go, cargo, nuget), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, docker, start and stop local servers
tools.read: read files in the working directory
tools.web_fetch: fetch public web pages and unauthenticated public APIs
tools.browser: drive a headless browser and take screenshots
tools.ask_user: ask the user a question and read the answer in the conversation

lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for any external service (cloud providers, SaaS products, GitHub or GitLab write access, package or model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)
public deployment or publishing to any hosted service
Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains
connectors or integrations other than the tools listed
